distance_method: BRepExtrema_DistShapeShape between boundary-face compounds of each original solid and the envelope. This avoids erroneous implicit interior classification observed on small decorative original solids. BRepAlgoAPI_Common was independently evaluated against all 9 original solids.
anomaly: Five small decorative solids returned raw solid-to-solid distance zero with nearest points outside their own bounding boxes. Both raw results and bounded-face results are retained in this report. Original geometry was not modified.
limits: Zero intersection and positive boundary distance do not prove that a volume is in the intended cavity; exterior free space also has those properties. Placement follows the known central cavity, but no watertight cavity solid was reconstructed.
The reference retains original industrial walls/ribs/posts. Rebuilding walls inward for FDM may reduce this clearance.
The 36 mm limit is a total study envelope. Real boards, headers, terminal blocks, plugs, bend radii and insertion/removal paths remain unvalidated.
Only the generic power reservation depth is reduced. No real component was shrunk to force a fit.
This is not a printable shell or final cassette; it does not validate fatigue, heat, electrical behavior or assembly motion.

corrected_cassette.note: Generic volumes only; no PCB shapes or functional joints.
